name: A Port of Call
condition: End your move on a page with one of your inklings on each adjacent page (minimum 2).

name: In the Ship’s Wake
condition: Place an Inkling on a page adjacent to one of your other Inklings, then discard a Twist.

name: Walk the Planks
condition: Place an inkling, then discard exactly one of you inklings from two adjacent books.
ongoing: When you place on last space, gain 2 ink.

name: The Final Verse
condition: Complete a conflict where you have no Inklings in the overflow.

name: Stand Shoulder to Shoulder
condition: Place an inkling on the last space of a book while you have at least 3 cards and 3 ink.
ongoing: If you have Inklings in each overflow, +2 power.
